---
title: "Does rounding angular errors change the fitted PDF?"
output: html_document
---

This simulation uses YL's 14 condition sizes and fitted parameter ranges. Each
synthetic error is recorded to 0.01 degrees. The same errors are fitted twice:
once at their recorded values, and once after rounding to the nearest degree.
Signal strength is held at its YL estimate so this check isolates the effect of
rounding on the fitted shape parameter. Both Cauchy-memory and von Mises-signal
models are checked.

```{r setup}
source("cauchy_model.R")
source("cauchy_runner.R")
source("MaxGumbelModel.R")
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(20261008)
n_simulations <- 200L
fit_grid_n <- 360L       # One-degree response grid used by the fitted models
sampling_grid_n <- 36000L  # 0.01-degree grid for generating synthetic errors
comparison_grid_n <- 3600L # 0.1-degree grid for comparing fitted PDFs

trials <- read.csv("../Daz25EncodingData/PreliminaryReview/YL_model_trials.csv")
cauchy_fit <- fit_cauchy_cells(trials, fit_grid_n)
vm_fit <- fit_max_gumbel_cells(trials, fit_grid_n)
stopifnot(identical(cauchy_fit$cells$cell, vm_fit$cells$cell),
          identical(cauchy_fit$cells$trials, vm_fit$cells$trials))

cases <- rbind(
  data.frame(model = "Cauchy memory", cell = cauchy_fit$cells$cell,
             trials = cauchy_fit$cells$trials,
             shape = cauchy_fit$cells$kappa,
             signal_strength = cauchy_fit$sensitivity),
  data.frame(model = "von Mises signal", cell = vm_fit$cells$cell,
             trials = vm_fit$cells$trials,
             shape = vm_fit$cells$kappa,
             signal_strength = vm_fit$amplitude)
)

predict_pdf <- function(model, shape, signal_strength, n) {
  if (model == "Cauchy memory") {
    caureport(c(shape, signal_strength), n)
  } else {
    max_gumbel_report(c(signal_strength, shape), n)
  }
}

# Precompute one high-resolution sampling distribution for each model and cell.
samplers <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cases)), function(i) {
  prediction <- with(cases[i, ],
                     predict_pdf(model, shape, signal_strength, sampling_grid_n))
  mass <- prediction$ptheta / sum(prediction$ptheta)
  list(angle_deg = prediction$theta * 180 / pi,
       cdf = c(0, cumsum(mass)))
})

draw_errors <- function(sampler, count) {
  index <- findInterval(runif(count), sampler$cdf, rightmost.closed = TRUE)
  index <- pmax(1L, pmin(index, length(sampler$angle_deg)))
  round(sampler$angle_deg[index], 2)
}

interpolated_ll <- function(prediction, errors_deg) {
  n <- length(prediction$theta)
  h <- 2 * pi / n
  position <- ((errors_deg * pi / 180 + pi) %% (2 * pi)) / h
  lower <- floor(position) + 1L
  upper <- (lower %% n) + 1L
  fraction <- position - floor(position)
  density <- (1 - fraction) * prediction$ptheta[lower] +
    fraction * prediction$ptheta[upper]
  -sum(log(pmax(density, .Machine$double.xmin)))
}

fit_shape <- function(errors_deg, model, signal_strength, rounded) {
  if (rounded) {
    index <- ((round(errors_deg) + 180) %% 360) + 1L
    objective <- function(shape) {
      prediction <- predict_pdf(model, shape, signal_strength, fit_grid_n)
      -sum(log(pmax(prediction$ptheta[index], .Machine$double.xmin)))
    }
  } else {
    objective <- function(shape) {
      prediction <- predict_pdf(model, shape, signal_strength, fit_grid_n)
      interpolated_ll(prediction, errors_deg)
    }
  }
  optimize(objective, interval = c(0.02, 10), tol = 1e-5)$minimum
}

pdf_misfit <- function(model, signal_strength, shape_original, shape_rounded) {
  original <- predict_pdf(model, shape_original, signal_strength,
                          comparison_grid_n)$ptheta
  rounded <- predict_pdf(model, shape_rounded, signal_strength,
                         comparison_grid_n)$ptheta
  h <- 2 * pi / comparison_grid_n
  c(total_variation = 0.5 * sum(abs(original - rounded)) * h,
    max_density_difference_per_degree = max(abs(original - rounded)) * pi / 180)
}
```

## Repeated simulations

Total variation is the main PDF misfit measure. It ranges from 0 to 1: for
example, 0.01 means the two curves differ by one percentage point of total
probability mass after accounting for their overlap. The maximum density
difference records the largest pointwise gap anywhere around the circle.

```{r simulate}
results <- vector("list", nrow(cases) * n_simulations)
row_number <- 0L
for (case_index in seq_len(nrow(cases))) {
  case <- cases[case_index, ]
  for (simulation in seq_len(n_simulations)) {
    errors_deg <- draw_errors(samplers[[case_index]], case$trials)
    shape_original <- fit_shape(errors_deg, case$model,
                                case$signal_strength, rounded = FALSE)
    shape_rounded <- fit_shape(errors_deg, case$model,
                               case$signal_strength, rounded = TRUE)
    misfit <- pdf_misfit(case$model, case$signal_strength,
                         shape_original, shape_rounded)
    row_number <- row_number + 1L
    results[[row_number]] <- data.frame(
      model = case$model, cell = case$cell, simulation = simulation,
      shape_original = shape_original, shape_rounded = shape_rounded,
      total_variation = unname(misfit["total_variation"]),
      max_density_difference_per_degree =
        unname(misfit["max_density_difference_per_degree"])
    )
  }
}
results <- do.call(rbind, results)

summarize_misfit <- function(x) {
  c(median = median(x), p95 = unname(quantile(x, 0.95)),
    p99 = unname(quantile(x, 0.99)), maximum = max(x))
}
overall <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(results, results$model), function(part) {
  data.frame(model = part$model[1], simulations = nrow(part),
             t(summarize_misfit(part$total_variation)), row.names = NULL)
}))
overall

by_cell <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(results, list(results$model, results$cell),
                                      drop = TRUE), function(part) {
  data.frame(model = part$model[1], cell = part$cell[1],
             t(summarize_misfit(part$total_variation)), row.names = NULL)
}))
by_cell[order(by_cell$model, by_cell$cell), ]
```

## Distribution of PDF misfit

```{r misfit-distribution, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
ggplot(results, aes(x = total_variation)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 35, fill = "grey60", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Total variation between fitted PDFs",
       y = "Simulation count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```

## Largest observed PDF difference

This is the most different pair among the simulated fits, not a typical pair.

```{r largest-misfit, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
worst <- results[which.max(results$total_variation), ]
case <- cases[cases$model == worst$model & cases$cell == worst$cell, ]
curve_original <- predict_pdf(worst$model, worst$shape_original,
                              case$signal_strength, comparison_grid_n)
curve_rounded <- predict_pdf(worst$model, worst$shape_rounded,
                             case$signal_strength, comparison_grid_n)
curves <- rbind(
  data.frame(error_deg = curve_original$theta * 180 / pi,
             density_deg = curve_original$ptheta * pi / 180,
             fit = "Original 0.01-degree errors"),
  data.frame(error_deg = curve_rounded$theta * 180 / pi,
             density_deg = curve_rounded$ptheta * pi / 180,
             fit = "Rounded whole-degree errors")
)
print(worst)
ggplot(curves, aes(error_deg, density_deg, colour = fit, linetype = fit)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-180, 180)) +
  labs(x = "Signed error (degrees)", y = "Density per degree",
       title = paste(worst$model, worst$cell, "simulation", worst$simulation)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```

```{r largest-misfit-difference, fig.width=10, fig.height=3}
difference_curve <- data.frame(
  error_deg = curve_original$theta * 180 / pi,
  density_difference_per_degree =
    (curve_original$ptheta - curve_rounded$ptheta) * pi / 180
)
ggplot(difference_curve, aes(error_deg, density_difference_per_degree)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(colour = "#C13C32", linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-180, 180)) +
  labs(x = "Signed error (degrees)",
       y = "Original minus rounded\ndensity per degree") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```
